```{python}
#| label: setup
#| output: false

import os
import polars as pl
import plotly.express as px
from databricks import sql
from dotenv import load_dotenv

load_dotenv()

# ── NHS brand colours ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
NHS_BLUE   = "#005EB8"
NHS_DARK   = "#003087"
NHS_GREEN  = "#009639"
NHS_AMBER  = "#FFB81C"
NHS_RED    = "#DA291C"
NHS_PURPLE = "#7C2855"

PRIORITY_COLOURS = {
    "2-Week Wait": NHS_RED,
    "Urgent":      NHS_AMBER,
    "Routine":     NHS_BLUE,
}

HOSPITAL_COLOURS = {
    "Glangwili General Hospital": NHS_BLUE,
    "Withybush General Hospital": NHS_DARK,
    "Prince Philip Hospital":     NHS_GREEN,
    "Bronglais General Hospital": NHS_PURPLE,
}

# ── Databricks connection ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
conn = sql.connect(
    server_hostname=os.environ["DATABRICKS_HOST"],
    http_path=os.environ["DATABRICKS_HTTP_PATH"],
    access_token=os.environ["DATABRICKS_TOKEN"],
)

# ── Load synthetic NHS Wales waiting list from Databricks compute ──────────────
query = """
SELECT * FROM (VALUES
    ('Glangwili General Hospital', 'Cardiology',    42,  'Urgent',       'RTT'),
    ('Glangwili General Hospital', 'Orthopaedics',  140, 'Urgent',       'RTT'),
    ('Glangwili General Hospital', 'Urology',        67, 'Routine',      'RTT'),
    ('Glangwili General Hospital', 'Dermatology',    89, 'Routine',      'RTT'),
    ('Glangwili General Hospital', 'Oncology',       12, '2-Week Wait',  '2WW'),
    ('Withybush General Hospital', 'Orthopaedics',  118, 'Routine',      'RTT'),
    ('Withybush General Hospital', 'Cardiology',     65, 'Urgent',       'RTT'),
    ('Withybush General Hospital', 'Urology',       134, 'Routine',      'RTT'),
    ('Withybush General Hospital', 'Dermatology',    45, 'Routine',      'RTT'),
    ('Withybush General Hospital', 'Oncology',        9, '2-Week Wait',  '2WW'),
    ('Prince Philip Hospital',     'Cardiology',     15, 'Routine',      'RTT'),
    ('Prince Philip Hospital',     'Orthopaedics',   92, 'Routine',      'RTT'),
    ('Prince Philip Hospital',     'Urology',        78, 'Urgent',       'RTT'),
    ('Prince Philip Hospital',     'Dermatology',    55, 'Routine',      'RTT'),
    ('Prince Philip Hospital',     'Oncology',        6, '2-Week Wait',  '2WW'),
    ('Bronglais General Hospital', 'Cardiology',     22, 'Routine',      'RTT'),
    ('Bronglais General Hospital', 'Oncology',        8, '2-Week Wait',  '2WW'),
    ('Bronglais General Hospital', 'Orthopaedics',  156, 'Routine',      'RTT'),
    ('Bronglais General Hospital', 'Urology',        98, 'Routine',      'RTT'),
    ('Bronglais General Hospital', 'Dermatology',    33, 'Urgent',       'RTT')
) AS t(hospital_site, specialty, days_waiting, priority_level, pathway)
"""

with conn.cursor() as cur:
    cur.execute(query)
    df = pl.DataFrame(
        cur.fetchall(),
        schema=["Hospital", "Specialty", "Days_Waiting", "Priority", "Pathway"],
        orient="row",
    )

conn.close()

# ── KPI calculations ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# NHS 18-week (126 day) referral-to-treatment target
RTT_THRESHOLD   = 126
total_patients  = df.height
avg_wait        = round(df["Days_Waiting"].mean(), 1)
max_wait        = df["Days_Waiting"].max()
breach_count    = df.filter(pl.col("Days_Waiting") > RTT_THRESHOLD).height
breach_pct      = round((breach_count / total_patients) * 100, 1)
```

## Row {height="420px"}

### Column {width=58%}

```{python}
#| title: "Average Waiting Days by Hospital Site"

df_hosp = (
    df.group_by("Hospital")
    .agg(pl.col("Days_Waiting").mean().round(1).alias("Avg_Wait"))
    .sort("Avg_Wait", descending=True)
)

fig = px.bar(
    df_hosp,
    x="Avg_Wait",
    y="Hospital",
    orientation="h",
    color="Hospital",
    color_discrete_map=HOSPITAL_COLOURS,
    text="Avg_Wait",
    labels={"Avg_Wait": "Avg Days Waiting", "Hospital": ""},
)
fig.add_vline(
    x=RTT_THRESHOLD,
    line_dash="dash",
    line_color=NHS_RED,
    annotation_text="18-wk target (126 days)",
    annotation_position="top right",
    annotation_font_color=NHS_RED,
)
fig.update_traces(texttemplate="%{text} days", textposition="outside")
fig.update_layout(
    showlegend=False,
    margin=dict(l=10, r=80, t=10, b=10),
    plot_bgcolor="white",
    xaxis=dict(showgrid=True, gridcolor="#e8e8e8"),
)
fig
```

### Column {width=42%}

```{python}
#| title: "Referrals by Priority Level"

df_priority = df.group_by("Priority").agg(pl.len().alias("Count"))

fig = px.pie(
    df_priority,
    names="Priority",
    values="Count",
    hole=0.55,
    color="Priority",
    color_discrete_map=PRIORITY_COLOURS,
)
fig.update_traces(
    textinfo="percent+label",
    textfont_size=13,
    pull=[0.03, 0.03, 0.03],
)
fig.update_layout(
    showlegend=True,
    legend=dict(orientation="h", yanchor="bottom", y=-0.15),
    margin=dict(l=10, r=10, t=10, b=40),
    annotations=[dict(
        text=f"<b>{total_patients}</b><br>Patients",
        x=0.5, y=0.5,
        font_size=16,
        showarrow=False,
    )],
)
fig
```

```{python}
#| title: "Full Waiting List Roster"

import plotly.graph_objects as go

# Colour-code rows by wait time severity
def row_colour(days):
    if days > RTT_THRESHOLD:
        return NHS_RED
    elif days > 84:
        return NHS_AMBER
    else:
        return "#ffffff"

row_colours = [row_colour(d) for d in df["Days_Waiting"].to_list()]

fig = go.Figure(
    go.Table(
        header=dict(
            values=["<b>Hospital</b>", "<b>Specialty</b>", "<b>Days Waiting</b>", "<b>Priority</b>", "<b>Pathway</b>"],
            fill_color=NHS_BLUE,
            font=dict(color="white", size=12),
            align="left",
            height=32,
        ),
        cells=dict(
            values=[
                df["Hospital"].to_list(),
                df["Specialty"].to_list(),
                df["Days_Waiting"].to_list(),
                df["Priority"].to_list(),
                df["Pathway"].to_list(),
            ],
            fill_color=[row_colours],
            font=dict(size=11),
            align="left",
            height=28,
        ),
    )
)
fig.update_layout(margin=dict(l=0, r=0, t=0, b=0))
fig
```
